हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: After losing her parents, Divya finds family, love, and belonging in Shalini’s home and her son Ishaan. But Ishaan’s growing trust in the manipulative Rohini turns Divya’s life into a nightmare of false accusations, humiliation, and abuse. Betrayed by the man she loves and forced to walk away with her dignity shattered, Divya rebuilds her life elsewhere. When the truth finally emerges, Ishaan is left with guilt, regret, and the irreversible cost of his blind faith.
